question: How tall must sign letters be to be read at a given distance (builder 4x8 on a 45 mph frontage)?
summary: Derived h = (v x t_read)/LI with LI~25-30 ft/in from 5-arcmin acuity; matches USSC VRD/LI and MUTCD 30 ft/in. Underestimated reaction time (5.6s vs USSC ~9s): 45 mph hero caps should be ~20in, not 12in. Minor novel framing: copy length on a fixed panel has a roughly quadratic legibility penalty.
